<thought>Now that we have the template ID (29646) and its SMARTS, we can apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor SMILES. The apply_template tool will return a list of precursor SMILES (or lists if multiple fragments). We'll use the target SMILES provided.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O", "template_id": "29646"}</action_input>
